notes.title: ** New Item Release & Limited Offer **
notes.notes:
http://share.logickorea.co.kr/LNK/Stuff/img/synthesisbox2.jpg

New item will be available on Point Store for a while!
For the next four weeks, we're going to bring Magic Stone Synthesis Box to the store.
It's a great way to make the best use of Magic Stone you got(in the game or from Magic Stone Sealing Box) but don't need.

You can have it until the maintenance on September 28th.
